name: watchdog
description: An external advisor model that watches the session transcript and injects notes, concerns and blockers back into the running agent.

model.title: Advisor model
model.description: Model alias/id for the Claude CLI (e.g. opus, sonnet), or the model name your OpenAI-compatible endpoint serves.

mode.title: Review mode
mode.description: turn: review during the run (every few tool calls) and at the end. final: review only when the agent is about to stop.

base_url.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL (optional)
base_url.description: Set to run the advisor on a non-Claude model, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1. Leave empty to use the Claude CLI.

api_key.title: API key for that endpoint (optional)
api_key.description: Bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
